blocks.text: Karbutilate is a post- and pre-emergent herbicide. It is a carbamate ester and substituted urea, and its formula is C14H21N3O3. After a 4-year development period, it was first sold in 1968, marketed under the name Tandex. It controls annual broadleaf weeds, grasses and vines, and is used in non-crop scenarios like drainage ditches and industrial sites.
